adjudication.rationale: In `TopicEmbed.import`, the category assignment changed from `category: SiteSetting.embed_category` to `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)` and `category: eh.try(:category_id)` (so `nil` when no matching host). The updated spec (`spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb`) only covers the matching-host path by fabricating an `embeddable_host` and asserting the topic category equals that host’s category; there is no coverage for the unmatched-host case where `eh` is `nil` and `PostCreator` receives `category: nil` (behavioral difference from the previous global `embed_category`).
